title: Fairness in AI for Education: A Modular Framework for Mitigating Bias in Dropout Prediction
summary: A modular experimental framework for studying and mitigating algorithmic bias in student dropout prediction, comparing fairness interventions and data-augmentation strategies (Faker, LLMs, GANs) across real-world education datasets. It uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer, driven by a SingleTableMetadata schema, to generate synthetic student records for studying class-imbalance impacts.
